title: Guts
declareNotice: Your turn — declare In (stay) or Out (fold).

guide.matchRisk: If you stay and lose: pay ~pot ({{pot}})

tutorial.info: This shows the round number, pot, ante, and each player's chips and status. Guts is a fast pot-vying gambling game where everyone holds 2 cards and simultaneously declares In (stay) or Out (fold).
tutorial.hand: Your two cards. Hands rank Pair > High card; the best hand among the players who stayed wins the pot.
tutorial.actions: Choose In (stay) to vie for the pot — if you lose you must match the pot. Choose Out (fold) to sit the round out.
tutorial.resetButton: Reset the game and start over.
